messages.ko: 새해복 많이받으세요~~~다들 설연휴 안전하고 즐겁고 행복하시길 ~~🤍🤍
messages.en: Happy New Year~~~ I hope everyone has a safe, enjoyable, and happy Lunar New Year holiday ~~🤍🤍.

messages.ko: 연휴니까 하고싶었던거 해보고싶었던거 먹고싶었던거 다 해볼수있기를 바랄게여
messages.en: Since it’s the holiday, I hope you can do everything you want to do, try everything you wanted to try, and eat everything you wanted to eat.
I’m going to rest during the Lunar New Year holiday too.
I’ll go to my grandma and grandpa’s house.
I’ll eat lots of delicious food and come back.
ㅎㅎㅎ
Absolutely.
Safety is.
Important.
Be careful driving, watch out for cars, and be careful of people.
Beware of dogs and be cautious of fires.
There might be dogs in the countryside ㅎㅎ.
What if I miss Hayeon during the Lunar New Year holidayㅠㅠ??
Then just see me!
When there’s a gap in my conversations with the adults.
If I find a moment.
I’ll contact you briefly.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
When Hayeon goes to her hometown, you should put on a cute performance~
I’ll perform enthusiastically.
I need to get double the allowance.
ㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹ
Is this the famous Jeong Hayeon who’s popular everywhere?~
Oh, but both of my younger cousins really like me.
Me.
They still beg me to play with them.

messages.ko: 나도 하연이랑 같이 마크 할 수 있는데........
messages.en: I could play Minecraft with Hayeon too........
I’m building an amusement park in Minecraft these days.
I’m going to make it really big!!

messages.ko: 마크 시작한지 별로 안됐는데 뭘 해야될지 모르겠어..괜히 산거 같애ㅜ
messages.en: I haven’t been playing Minecraft for long, but I don’t know what to do... I feel like I bought it for no reasonㅜ.
I wish I could teach you.
If you played with me, you’d want to play all the time.
ㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹ
I’ll show you the amusement park once it’s finished.
Then, have a warm and satisfying Lunar New Year holiday.
Catch up on the sleep you missed.
And play games as much as you want.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ
I’ll contact you if I have time!!
Love you💝
